methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics) - الوحدة 9
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية الدرس في كتاب الطالب.

sources.topic_1: Student Book - Writing (My Favourite Sport / Fitness Activity)

topics.title: Write about your favourite sport or fitness activity.
guiding_questions: What would you like to become one day?
topics.sample_essay: My favourite sport is swimming. I like it because it is fun. It keeps me healthy. In summer, I go to a nearby pool. In winter, I swim indoors. I am in the school team. We race against other schools. I train twice a week. I want to be a professional athlete one day.
